research_unit.alef_variant_rule: آ is researched under ا and does not get a separate run
research_unit.next_letter_gate: Complete current-letter research, internal source/orthography checks, level allocation, report, and task-status update before proceeding; project-owner review is not required unless explicitly requested.
research_unit.quota_policy: No mandatory minimum or quota; no numeric ceiling unless set by the project owner before the run
research_unit.default_stop_rule: Stop after relevant source searches and independent query variants yield no new distinct, defensible candidates

field_definitions.normalized_term: Deduplication form; normalize ي to ی, ك to ک, extra spaces, and whitespace variants
field_definitions.initial_letter: Persian research letter; آ is represented by ا
field_definitions.category_id: One category identifier from the project taxonomy
field_definitions.level: Primary selected level for compatibility; use assigned_levels as the authoritative list when a word is shared across levels
field_definitions.definition: Short explanation sufficient to disambiguate the entry
field_definitions.status: approved (fully source-verified and publishable), provisionally_accepted (passed lightweight structural/orthographic checks based on prior research; not publishable until full source adjudication), needs_review, or rejected
field_definitions.alternative_spellings: Accepted spelling variants that are not separate records
field_definitions.review_note: Adjudication notes, ambiguity, or supporting context
field_definitions.rejection_reason: Required when status is rejected; otherwise null or empty
field_definitions.reviewed_at: Review date in YYYY-MM-DD format, or null if not reviewed
field_definitions.selection_status: selected or reserve; separate from lexical validation
field_definitions.assigned_levels: Semicolon-separated difficulty levels; authoritative for multi-level assignments

record_example.review_note: نمونه ساختاری؛ برای انتشار تأیید نشده است.

selection_rules.distinct_word_count: Deduplicate semantic answer families; varieties of ash count as one
selection_rules.allocation: Up to 3 easiest distinct terms for easy; up to 5 different medium; up to 10 remaining distinct hard
selection_rules.hard_reuse: When fewer than 10 distinct candidates remain, reuse hardest medium then easy entries in hard; if fewer than 10 total, include all in hard
selection_rules.approval: Selection is separate from lexical approval; source validation remains required
selection_rules.multi_level_storage: assigned_levels authoritative; level stores easiest assigned level
